reset.darkmusic.title: Reset DarkMusic?
reset.darkmusic.help: Reset settings, key binds, HUD layout, download history, and caches. Keep music, playlists, and download tools.
reset.darkmusic.body:
Restore default settings, key binds, volume, speed, HUD layout, scale, and music folder path. Stop playback and downloads. Clear download history and caches.

Keep your music, videos, playlists, installed download tools, and configured tool paths. Clearing download history lets the same videos download again.
